This appears to be a mixed meal of browned meat, a little rice, broccoli, and mixed vegetables/salad.

The rounded-square dinner plate is approximately **26 cm across**. Using the requested circular approximation, its area is **3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm²**.

Visible foods include broccoli, browned meat with a light sauce/coating, white rice, leafy greens/shredded cabbage, orange wedges, pale chunks, and green beans.
